architecture_summary.description: Serverless architecture utilizing a synchronous request-response pattern via API Gateway and Lambda, with NoSQL persistence.

architecture_findings.description: Lack of robust authentication (IAM/Cognito) identified for the public endpoint.
Synchronous processing may lead to timeouts during peak traffic loads.
Reduce CloudWatch log retention periods to optimize storage expenses.
Multiple Lambda functions used for a single, centralized business logic.
Implementation of SQS recommended to decouple components and ensure elasticity.
